statement: A scanner pointed at a bundled artifact (syft on a Node SEA binary, BuildKit on an image whose package.json has no dependencies) reports an empty or runtime-only inventory and the step still passes. Rule: take the inventory from the bundler's own metafile plus the lockfile, and make a check refuse an SBOM with no package beyond the root or with an all-zero checksum; a present SBOM file is not evidence of an inventory. Separately, a fixture reconstructed from a description because the real asset could not be fetched must say so inside the fixture.
